//: Minimal mango config: copy to your project root as .harness.json, replace each REPLACE_ME, create tickets_dir, and create the rule book file at rulebook_path (an empty file is enough to start: doctor warns it is a stub, it does not fail; or run /mango:init to scaffold one). It carries the keys doctor requires plus pr_host, with no tracker (local mode: tickets are <tickets_dir>/<KEY>.md). Every other key is optional and documented in harness.example.json. No secrets here — tokens go in a gitignored .env.
test_command: REPLACE_ME (e.g. the single command that runs your test suite)
pr_host: REPLACE_ME (e.g. the host/command used to open a pull request)
